triage.instructions: How much specification work does the request need before a coding agent can carry it out well?

criteria.trivial: A tiny, unambiguous edit such as a typo, a rename, or a one-line change
criteria.ready: Already a detailed, structured specification with tasks and verification steps
criteria.rough: An informal or brief request that benefits from being turned into a structured specification

archetype.instructions: What kind of work does the request ask for?

criteria.bugfix: Fix incorrect behaviour, an error, a crash, or a regression in existing code
criteria.feature: Add new functionality, an option, a flag, a command, an endpoint, or a capability
criteria.refactor: Restructure, rename, move, or clean up existing code while keeping its behaviour the same
criteria.tests: Add, fix, or stabilise automated tests, including flaky tests
criteria.docs: Change documentation, README text, comments, wording, or typos
criteria.config: Change configuration, dependencies, versions, build scripts, CI, or tooling
criteria.perf: Make something faster or use less memory or resources
criteria.research: Investigate, explain, compare, review, or answer a question about the code
criteria.ui: Change the layout, styling, or components of a user interface

complexity.instructions: How much work does the request involve?
criteria: A single small change in one place
A focused change touching a few closely related places
Several coordinated changes, or a design decision to make first
Large or cross-cutting work that needs to be split into phases

risk.instructions: How much damage could a mistake in this change cause?
criteria: Low: easy to undo, with no effect on data, security, or public interfaces
Moderate: touches shared code, public interfaces, or configuration
High: involves data migration, security, authentication, payments, deletion, or production infrastructure

multi_task.instructions: Does the request ask for two or more separate pieces of work that should each be checked on their own?

vague.instructions: Is the request so vague that the finished result is unclear without asking the user questions first?

needs_research.instructions: Does carrying out the request require reading external documentation or learning an unfamiliar library or API?

ui.instructions: Does the request change something a person sees or clicks in a graphical or web interface?

autonomous.instructions: Is the request about building or instructing an agent that acts on its own, processes untrusted content with tools, or delegates work to sub-agents?

faithful.instructions: Does the specification ask for what the request asks for, with nothing important missing and nothing unrelated added?

fit.instructions: How well do the specification's task type and guidance fit the request?
criteria: Poor: the wrong kind of task, or guidance that would mislead
Partial: the right kind of task, but some guidance is irrelevant
Good: the task type and guidance fit the request
